info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Enterprise Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Security Advisory Retrieval API allows users to obtain specific security advisory details related to enterprise services based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is crucial for organizations seeking targeted security advisory information to inform their operational strategies. Typical consumers include compliance officers and IT security teams who need to access this data for risk assessment and mitigation purposes. By providing these resources, the API enhances risk management and security posture within enterprises.

get.description: Fetches the complete details of the specified security advisory identified by the given resource ID. This endpoint provides essential information regarding threats, vulnerabilities, and applicable mitigations.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to provide the required parameters and data necessary to retrieve security advisory details for the specified resource. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema to facilitate successful API interactions.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the advisory details.
